privacyIntro: HiddenSpots protects your private nature spots. We do not sell personal data and we do not expose SECRET coordinates without your consent.
privacyData: Account (name, email), locations you create, visits, collections, trips, uploaded photos, and map/language preferences. Data lives in PostgreSQL (Neon); photos use Vercel Blob when configured.
privacyShare: Share links are optional. SECRET locations show fuzzed coordinates. You can revoke a link anytime.
privacyRights: Export all data or permanently delete your account from Settings. Deletion is irreversible.
privacyContact: For privacy questions, contact the app operator via your published support channel.
termsIntro: You use HiddenSpots at your own risk. It is a personal nature atlas — not a substitute for official maps or safety advice.
termsUse: Do not share sensitive spots without permission, upload illegal content, or attempt to harm the service or other users.
termsContent: You retain ownership of content you upload. You grant us a license to store and display it to operate the service.
termsLiability: The service is provided as-is. We are not liable for field accidents, navigation errors, or data loss beyond what the law requires.
